sloka: प्रभ्रष्टो ऽथ करात्तस्य प्रतोदः सारथेस्तदा।पपात सहसा चैव ध्वजस्तस्य च रक्षसः ।। ६.७८.१७ ।।
transliteration: prabhraṣṭo 'tha karāttasya pratodaḥ sārathestadā।papāta sahasā caiva dhvajastasya ca rakṣasaḥ ।। 6.78.17 ।।

translations.english: There, the long whip dropped from the charioteer's hand and the Rakshasa's standard had fallen suddenly by divine will.
